command: GROK_HOME=<empty temp dir> grok login --oauth, killed after it printed its sign-in prompt
method: The URL is read from the CLI's own stdout prompt. No browser was opened, no code was approved, and the isolated GROK_HOME was deleted. Repeat captures (4 runs) produced the same parameter set, the same order, and the same values except redirect_uri port, code_challenge, state, and nonce.

stableParameters.scope: openid profile email offline_access grok-cli:access api:access conversations:read conversations:write workspaces:read workspaces:write

stateAndNonceShape: UUID; both values in one run share a timestamp prefix
notes: No access token, refresh token, email, or user id is recorded. The authorize URL is a request the CLI would open; it was never approved. This copy is committed so the test that compares against it runs from a clean clone; parity/pi-xai-oauth/report.md names it as the XAI-001 evidence.
